in_urdu.name: فشان

in_english.name: Fashan
in_english.meaning: Derived from Arabic, meaning widely spread or extensively dispersed
in_english.long_meaning: The name Fashan originates from the Arabic root ف-ش-ى (f-š-ʿ), which conveys the idea of spreading or dispersing. This root is related to concepts of expansion, proliferation, or widespread distribution. In Islamic tradition, names derived from this root are often associated with positive attributes such as generosity, abundance, or the dissemination of knowledge. Historically, the name Fashan may have been used to signify someone who brings or spreads goodness, prosperity, or enlightenment.
